gaps.explanation: Two printed parts, no missing or duplicated line. (1) 47,291: the Bond Fund budget schedule p10 prints 'Transfer out' 47,291 inside its Total disbursements 216,174 (120,000 + 48,413 + 470 + 47,291), and the governmental funds statement p4 prints the whole 216,174 as 'Debt service'; the JSON statement keeps it in spending as printed (disbursement line 'Transfers Out' 47,291, split_from Debt service), while detail[] records it as an other-financing 'Transfers Out' (-47,291, Bond Fund) - transfers are never spending in detail, so it is correctly outside the expenditure section. (2) -2: the p11 Combining Schedule (General Fund columns) prints Total disbursements 773,361, but its printed cells add to 773,363 (report rounding). Statement total 989,535 = 773,361 + 216,174; detail expenditure 942,246 = 773,363 + 168,883 (Bond 120,000 + 48,413 + 470). Gap 47,289 = 47,291 - 2. Nothing to add or remove.
